alternativeHeadline: How Sitekit structures a learning path
articleBody:
Sitekit learning paths combine courses, classrooms, and practice tasks into a clear sequence. Start with outcomes, then map each module to a single skill so learners always know what “done” looks like.

Keep each step short enough to finish in one sitting. Sitekit’s display pages and collections make it easy to surface the next recommended lesson without burying learners in menus.

alternativeHeadline: Designing classrooms that keep learners engaged
articleBody:
A Sitekit classroom works best when the first viewport answers three questions: what is this class, who is teaching it, and what happens next. Use a strong hero, a short syllabus, and a single primary action.

Reduce chrome. One CTA beats five competing links. Sitekit fragments for headings, media, and lists are enough for most classroom pages.
